title: Google's Gemini Can Now Stomp Around as a Humanoid Robot - Slashdot
excerpt: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2 combines vision, language, and action models to control multiple types of robots, including humanoids performing tasks such as organizing shelves, tying bags, and replacing lightbulbs. content_html:
Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2 combines vision, language, and action models to control multiple types of robots, including humanoids performing tasks such as organizing shelves, tying bags, and replacing lightbulbs. "It's another milestone in our path towards really getting towards what we call like physical AGI, which means we get a robot to do anything that a human can," Carolina Parada, head of robotics at Google DeepMind, tells WIRED. From the report: Gemini Robotics 2 combines several different AI models into a single system. Taken together, they allow a robot to make sense of its surroundings and how to act in it. A vision language model (VLM), which understands images and video, can communicate with humans and reason how to perform different tasks. Two vision language action (VLA) models, trained to understand how to move in physical space, control the robot's full-body movement as well as the movements of grippers or hands.

In video demonstrations shared ahead of the release, the company showed several different robots performing complex tasks autonomously using the amalgamated model. In one demo, Apptronik's Apollo 2 robot used hands from a company called Sharpa to tidy shelves. Google DeepMind trained the model to perform these tasks using a mix of human teleoperation, video examples, and simulations -- it's not yet possible for AI models to perform a wide range of complex tasks without specific training.

[...] Parada says Google takes a multi-layered approach to safety, with guardrails applied on each model layer. It's also introducing ASIMOV-Agentic, a new benchmark for measuring the safety of various AI systems collaborating to control a robot. The benchmark detects whether a command will result in harmful or uncertain outcome.

sentences.en: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2 combines vision, language, and action models to control multiple types of robots, including humanoids performing tasks such as organizing shelves, tying bags, and replacing lightbulbs.
sentences.zh: Google DeepMind 的 Gemini Robotics 2 结合了视觉、语言和动作模型来控制多种类型的机器人，包括执行整理货架、系袋子和更换灯泡等任务的类人机器人。

sentences.en: "It's another milestone in our path towards really getting towards what we call like physical AGI, which means we get a robot to do anything that a human can," Carolina Parada, head of robotics at Google DeepMind, tells WIRED.
sentences.zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 机器人技术主管 Carolina Parada 告诉《连线》杂志：“这是我们真正实现物理 AGI 道路上的另一个里程碑，这意味着我们让机器人可以做人类能做的任何事情。”

sentences.en: From the report: Gemini Robotics 2 combines several different AI models into a single system.
sentences.zh: 报告摘自：Gemini Robotics 2 将几种不同的人工智能模型整合到一个系统中。

sentences.en: Taken together, they allow a robot to make sense of its surroundings and how to act in it.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，它们使机器人能够理解周围的环境以及如何在其中行动。

sentences.en: A vision language model (VLM), which understands images and video, can communicate with humans and reason how to perform different tasks.
sentences.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）可以理解图像和视频，可以与人类交流并推理如何执行不同的任务。

sentences.en: Two vision language action (VLA) models, trained to understand how to move in physical space, control the robot's full-body movement as well as the movements of grippers or hands.
sentences.zh: 两个视觉语言动作（VLA）模型经过训练，可以理解如何在物理空间中移动，控制机器人的全身运动以及抓手或手的运动。

sentences.en: In video demonstrations shared ahead of the release, the company showed several different robots performing complex tasks autonomously using the amalgamated model.
sentences.zh: 在发布前分享的视频演示中，该公司展示了几个不同的机器人使用合并模型自主执行复杂的任务。

sentences.en: In one demo, Apptronik's Apollo 2 robot used hands from a company called Sharpa to tidy shelves.
sentences.zh: 在一次演示中，Apptronik 的 Apollo 2 机器人使用 Sharpa 公司的双手来整理货架。

sentences.en: Google DeepMind trained the model to perform these tasks using a mix of human teleoperation, video examples, and simulations -- it's not yet possible for AI models to perform a wide range of complex tasks without specific training. [...]
sentences.zh: Google DeepMind 使用人类远程操作、视频示例和模拟的组合来训练模型来执行这些任务——如果没有特定的训练，人工智能模型还不可能执行各种复杂的任务。 [...]

sentences.en: Parada says Google takes a multi-layered approach to safety, with guardrails applied on each model layer.
sentences.zh: 帕拉达表示，谷歌采取了多层安全方法，在每个模型层都应用了护栏。

sentences.en: It's also introducing ASIMOV-Agentic, a new benchmark for measuring the safety of various AI systems collaborating to control a robot.
sentences.zh: 它还推出了 ASIMOV-Agentic，这是一个新的基准，用于测量协作控制机器人的各种人工智能系统的安全性。

sentences.en: The benchmark detects whether a command will result in harmful or uncertain outcome.
sentences.zh: 该基准检测命令是否会导致有害或不确定的结果。

content_html_zh: Google DeepMind 的 Gemini Robotics 2 结合了视觉、语言和动作模型来控制多种类型的机器人，包括执行整理货架、系袋子和更换灯泡等任务的类人机器人。 谷歌 DeepMind 机器人技术主管 Carolina Parada 告诉《连线》杂志：“这是我们真正实现物理 AGI 道路上的另一个里程碑，这意味着我们让机器人可以做人类能做的任何事情。” 报告摘自：Gemini Robotics 2 将几种不同的人工智能模型整合到一个系统中。 总而言之，它们使机器人能够理解周围的环境以及如何在其中行动。 视觉语言模型（VLM）可以理解图像和视频，可以与人类交流并推理如何执行不同的任务。 两个视觉语言动作（VLA）模型经过训练，可以理解如何在物理空间中移动，控制机器人的全身运动以及抓手或手的运动。 在发布前分享的视频演示中，该公司展示了几个不同的机器人使用合并模型自主执行复杂的任务。 在一次演示中，Apptronik 的 Apollo 2 机器人使用 Sharpa 公司的双手来整理货架。 Google DeepMind 使用人类远程操作、视频示例和模拟的组合来训练模型来执行这些任务——如果没有特定的训练，人工智能模型还不可能执行各种复杂的任务。 [...] 帕拉达表示，谷歌采取了多层安全方法，在每个模型层都应用了护栏。 它还推出了 ASIMOV-Agentic，这是一个新的基准，用于测量协作控制机器人的各种人工智能系统的安全性。 该基准检测命令是否会导致有害或不确定的结果。
